title: Evergine binding manifest
description: Declares where a binding's upstream specification lives, how it is generated and what it publishes. Read by both the deterministic reusable workflows and the agentic workflows.

toolbox.description: Toolbox version this manifest was written against. The toolbox-updater compares it with the current release to decide whether a manifest migration is needed.

project.description: Path to the binding .csproj, relative to the repository root.

runtime-identifier.description: RID passed to the build, e.g. win-x64. Empty means portable.

kind.description: Adapter used to fetch the specification. See docs/adapters/.

language.description: Language the upstream project is written in (c, cpp, rust, zig, ...). Informational: it tells the agent what kind of source it is reasoning about. The binding output is always C#.

project.description: Home of the upstream project. Used to look up releases and derive the upstream version.

version-from.description: How to determine which upstream version the vendored spec corresponds to.

sources.description: One entry per file or tree that feeds the generator.

url.description: Direct download URL. Required for kind: http-file.

repo.description: owner/name of the upstream repository. Required for kind: git-tree and git-submodule.

ref.description: Branch, tag or SHA to read from. Required for kind: git-tree.

remote-path.description: Path inside the upstream repository. Required for kind: git-tree.

path.description: Destination path in this repository, relative to the root.

format.description: How the file must be parsed. Decoupled from `language` on purpose: a Rust project exposing a C API is language: rust, format: c-header.

project.description: Path to the generator .csproj, relative to the repository root.

name.description: Generator/binding name, matching the generator-name input of the reusable workflows.

output.description: Directory the generator writes into. Agents treat changes here as generated output, never as hand-written code.

agents.description: Per-repository overrides for the agentic workflows. Every field is optional; omitting the block accepts the toolbox defaults.

model.description: Copilot model id. Overrides the toolbox default for this repository.

max-ai-credits.description: Hard spending ceiling for a single run, in GitHub AI Credits (1 credit = $0.01).
